heroTitle: Compress PDF to 100KB Without Losing Quality
heroDescription: Shrink your PDF files down to 100KB or less directly in your browser. Perfect for email attachments and fast sharing. 100% private.

sections.subTitle: Local Compression Engine
sections.subContent: Our advanced WASM engine compresses your PDF locally. No file limits.

sections.subTitle: Zero Data Retention
sections.subContent: Since files never leave your device, your private data remains yours alone.

sections.subTitle: Lightning Fast 100KB
sections.subContent: Hit your 100KB target size in milliseconds without server delays.
